author: Sixth Front
description: Sit inside your vehicles. In a tank, press C (CROUCH on phones) to take the commander's seat: vision blocks to look out of, the gun breech recoiling beside you, a rack of rounds behind, a live gunner's sight screen and switch panels. With the Jets or Bombers mod, C switches to the cockpit: jets get a full working cockpit: three screens with twenty option buttons each and five pages (radar, stores, map, attitude, engine), an up-front keypad with its data display, switch and knob panels down both consoles, sixteen caution lights with master caution, standby instruments and the buttons on the stick and throttle, a stick and throttle that move with you and a HUD in green; bombers get a framed flight deck with gauges, control wheels, four throttles and a co-pilot. In a helicopter you fly from the raised back seat with the gunner below in front (the Ka-52 seats you side by side with your co-pilot): canopy frames, a cyclic stick and collective lever that move with you, a live tactical map and flight screen (the Mi-24 has round gauges), dark Western cockpits and turquoise Russian ones.
